insight: Runs on OpenAI's open-source Whisper model and offers genuinely uncapped transcription on its flat-rate Unlimited plan.
name: TurboScribe
tagline: Unlimited audio and video transcription powered by Whisper.
description: TurboScribe converts audio and video files into text using OpenAI's Whisper speech-to-text model. It supports 98+ languages, automatic speaker recognition and translation of transcripts or subtitles into 134+ languages, with exports to formats like DOCX, PDF, SRT and VTT. A free tier allows three transcriptions a day, while the paid Unlimited plan removes usage caps for a flat monthly fee.
edge: Genuinely uncapped transcription for a flat ~$10/month, versus the per-minute or monthly-hour caps most rivals impose.
pros: Exports to DOCX, PDF, SRT, and VTT
cons: Free tier capped at 3 files/day, 30 minutes each
